layout_profile.info: Physical export profile: default, gt2n_sram or gt2n_logic

boundary_ports.info: Named signal ports: name, net, side, layer, optional zero-based track; see docs/constraints.md

placement_constraints.info: Hard fixed/order/align/mirror rules; placement columns use odd PC indices; see docs/constraints.md

allow_unequal_rows.info: [PLACEMENT] Allow unequal PMOS/NMOS finger counts and size the canvas from the larger row

enforce_diffusion_alignment.info: [PLACEMENT] Require matching PMOS/NMOS diffusion breaks; set false for independent row placement

minimum_gate_cut_length.info: [TECH] Minimum gate cut length in CPP

lisd_routing.info: [TECH] Use LISD as a routing resource

lig_routing.info: [TECH] Use LIG as a routing resource

supervia.info: [TECH] List of layers that allow to use supervia

mar_c2c_rule.info: [TECH] Center-to-center minimum area rule for metals

eol_c2c_rule.info: [TECH] Center-to-center end of line rule for metals

insert_num_db.info: [TECH] Maximum number of diffusion breaks allowed to use

polygon_cell.info: [TECH] Encourage DH to make polygon cells

use_objective_set.info: [SOLVER] Set of objectives to use. If not set, a default set will be used.

model_preset.info: [SOLVER] Model preset ID used for solving

num_search_workers.info: [SOLVER] Number of cores to use for solving

use_strategy.info: [SOLVER] Use decision strategy to speedup feasibility discovery

routing_tolerance.info: [SPEEDUP] Allowable routing distance to go beyond window in CPP

close_in_low_degree_net.info: [SPEEDUP] Enforce 2-pin nets to be diffusion shared

use_placement_order_for_identical_transi.info: [SPEEDUP] Enforce identical transistors to be placed in a certain order

inject_edge.info: [INJECT] Inject edge(s) to be used (u_layer, u_row, u_col, v_layer, v_row, v_col) : 0 or 1

inject_arc.info: [INJECT] Inject arc(s) to be used (net_name, u_layer, u_row, u_col, v_layer, v_row, v_col) : 0 or 1

inject_flow.info: [INJECT] Inject flow(s) to be used (net_name, k_idx, u_layer, u_row, u_col, v_layer, v_row, v_col) : 0 or 1

inject_placement.info: [INJECT] Inject placement(s) to be used (tran_name, x, y, flip)

inject_track.info: [INJECT] Inject a track to be used on a layer (layer, row/col_idx)

m0_pin_separation.info: [PIN] Enforce M0 pin separation across different rows

m0_pin_extension.info: [PIN] Extend M0 pin to vacancy edges
